arm_length = 80.0
arm_radius = 6.0

rib_end = rib_start + rib_width

    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

arm_length = 80.0

hole_spacing = 8.0

countersink_diameter = 6.6

base = Pos(0, 0, base_thickness/2) * Cylinder(base_diameter/2, base_thickness)

base = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

arm1 = Pos(-arm_offset, 0, base_thickness + arm_height/2) * Box(arm_width, arm_length, arm_height)
arm2 = Pos(arm_offset, 0, base_thickness + arm_height/2) * Box(arm_width, arm_length, arm_height)
result = base + arm1 + arm2

total_height = base_thickness + arm_height
result = result - Pos(0, arm_length/2, total_height/2) * Cylinder(central_hole_diameter/2, total_height + 10)

for x in [-arm_offset, arm_offset]:
